lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Unit performance task: verifying rules locally rather than assuming

objective: Learners compile a guide to navigating three public systems relevant to them, each entry verified against a current local source rather than assumed, completing this unit's performance task.
scenario: The learner assembles a guide covering three public systems from this unit (chosen from the service researched on day two, the record types from day three, and the office contacted on day five, or a fresh third system), each entry stating what it is, how to access it, and the source that verified it as current.
materials: research and notes from earlier lessons this unit
a notebook or document for the compiled guide

tasks.directions: Choose three public systems from this unit to include in your guide.

prompts.text: Name the three systems you're including and why each is genuinely useful to you.

tasks.directions: For each of the three systems, write a guide entry stating what it is, how to access it, and the source that verified it.

prompts.text: Write the guide entry for system one: what it is, how to access it, and your verifying source.
Write the guide entry for system two.
Write the guide entry for system three.
Every entry names a specific, current source, not an assumption.

tasks.directions: Re-verify one entry against a second source to confirm it wasn't outdated when first found.

prompts.text: State which entry you re-verified, the second source, and whether it confirmed or changed your original finding.

tasks.directions: Reflect on the unit as a whole.

prompts.text: Looking at your finished guide, what is the single biggest difference between what you assumed about public systems before this unit and what you actually found?

remediation: If a learner's guide entries state information without naming a specific source, or the source is not genuinely current, reteach by requiring each entry to name the exact source and roughly when it was checked, using day one's two-source verification habit as the model to reapply here.
extension: Have the learner add a fourth entry covering a public system relevant to a different life stage (such as one useful to an older adult) and compare what changes about how it's accessed.
